finding_text: The confirmatory study tests root-purpose availability under workflow conditions; only purpose provenance and workflow-level global guards are direct policy links.
APE measures harmful-persuasion attempts in model-to-model simulation; it is E0 and does not measure human persuasion or agency transfer.
MASK measures pressured lies of commission relative to elicited model beliefs; it is E0 and does not measure manipulation effectiveness or agency transfer.
Controlled evidence reaches E2: political attitude shifts, partial one-month persistence and low-cost actions; vote choice, naturalistic reach, dependency and agency transfer remain unestablished.
Observed incidents motivate mechanism and control design but do not by themselves establish election-result causality.
